verses.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.pt: Mas o povo, vendo que Moisés tardava em descer do monte, acercou-se de Arão, e lhe disse: Levanta-te, faze-nos um deus que vá adiante de nós; porque, quanto a esse Moisés, o homem que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.
verses.en_web: When the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the people saw that Moses was a long time coming down from the mountain, they all came to Aaron and said to him, Come, make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.

verses.en: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
verses.pt: E Arão lhes disse: Tirai os pendentes de ouro que estão nas orelhas de vossas mulheres, de vossos filhos e de vossas filhas, e trazei-mos.
verses.en_web: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Aaron said to them, Take off the gold rings which are in the ears of your wives and your sons and your daughters, and give them to me.

verses.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.pt: Então todo o povo, tirando os pendentes de ouro que estavam nas suas orelhas, os trouxe a Arão;
verses.en_web: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people took the gold rings from their ears and gave them to Aaron.

verses.en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: ele os recebeu de suas mãos, e com um buril deu forma ao ouro, e dele fez um bezerro de fundição. Então eles exclamaram: Eis aqui, ó Israel, o teu deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molten calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
verses.en_bbe: And he took the gold from them and, hammering it with an instrument, he made it into the metal image of a young ox: and they said, This is your god, O Israel, who took you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
verses.pt: E Arão, vendo isto, edificou um altar diante do bezerro e, fazendo uma proclamação, disse: Amanhã haverá festa ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Aaron saw this, he made an altar before it, and made a public statement, saying, Tomorrow there will be a feast to the Lord.

verses.en: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.pt: No dia seguinte levantaram-se cedo, ofereceram holocaustos, e trouxeram ofertas pacíficas; e o povo sentou-se a comer e a beber; depois levantou-se para folgar.
verses.en_web: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.en_bbe: So early on the day after they got up and made burned offerings and peace-offerings; and took their seats at the feast, and then gave themselves to pleasure.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Vai, desce; porque o teu povo, que fizeste subir da terra do Egito, se corrompeu;
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, who you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down quickly; for your people, whom you took out of the land of Egypt, are turned to evil ways;

verses.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: depressa se desviou do caminho que eu lhe ordenei; eles fizeram para si um bezerro de fundição, e adoraram-no, e lhe ofereceram sacrifícios, e disseram: Eis aqui, ó Israel, o teu deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molten calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
verses.en_bbe: Even now they are turned away from the rule I gave them, and have made themselves a metal ox and given worship to it and offerings, saying, This is your god, O Israel, who took you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Tenho observado este povo, e eis que é povo de dura cerviz.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, I have been watching this people, and I see that they are a stiff-necked people.

verses.en: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, deixa-me, para que a minha ira se acenda contra eles, e eu os consuma; e eu farei de ti uma grande nação.
verses.en_web: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
verses.en_bbe: Now do not get in my way, for my wrath is burning against them; I will send destruction on them, but of you I will make a great nation.

verses.en: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.pt: Moisés, porém, suplicou ao Senhor seu Deus, e disse: ç Senhor, por que se acende a tua ira contra o teu povo, que tiraste da terra do Egito com grande força e com forte mão?
verses.en_web: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.en_bbe: But Moses made prayer to God, saying, Lord, why is your wrath burning against your people whom you took out of the land of Egypt, with great power and with the strength of your hand?

verses.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.pt: Por que hão de falar os egípcios, dizendo: Para mal os tirou, para matá-los nos montes, e para destruí-los da face da terra?. Torna-te da tua ardente ira, e arrepende-te deste mal contra o teu povo.
verses.en_web: Why should the Egyptians speak, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth?’ Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.
verses.en_bbe: Why let the Egyptians say, He took them out to an evil fate, to put them to death on the mountains, cutting them off from the earth? Let your wrath be turned away from them, and send not this evil on your people.

verses.en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.pt: Lembra-te de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel, teus servos, aos quais por ti mesmo juraste, e lhes disseste: Multiplicarei os vossos descendentes como as estrelas do céu, e lhes darei toda esta terra de que tenho falado, e eles a possuirão por herança para sempre.
verses.en_web: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
verses.en_bbe: Have in mind Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you gave your oath, saying, I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and all this land will I give to your seed, as I said, to be their heritage for ever.

verses.en: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor se arrependeu do mal que dissera que havia de fazer ao seu povo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh repented of the evil which he said he would do to his people.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord let himself be turned from his purpose of sending punishment on his people.

verses.en: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.pt: E virou-se Moisés, e desceu do monte com as duas tábuas do testemunho na mão, tábuas escritas de ambos os lados; de um e de outro lado estavam escritas.
verses.en_web: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other they were written.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses came down the mountain with the two stones of the law in his hand; the stones had writing on their two sides, on the front and on the back.

verses.en: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.pt: E aquelas tábuas eram obra de Deus; também a escritura era a mesma escritura de Deus, esculpida nas tábuas.
verses.en_web: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
verses.en_bbe: The stones were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, cut on the stones.

verses.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.pt: Ora, ouvindo Josué a voz do povo que jubilava, disse a Moisés: Alarido de guerra há no arraial.
verses.en_web: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
verses.en_bbe: Now when the noise and the voices of the people came to the ears of Joshua, he said to Moses, There is a noise of war in the tents.

verses.en: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Moisés: Não é alarido dos vitoriosos, nem alarido dos vencidos, mas é a voz dos que cantam que eu ouço.
verses.en_web: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, It is not the voice of men who are overcoming in the fight, or the cry of those who have been overcome; it is the sound of songs which comes to my ear.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.pt: Chegando ele ao arraial e vendo o bezerro e as danças, acendeu-se-lhe a ira, e ele arremessou das mãos as tábuas, e as despedaçou ao pé do monte.
verses.en_web: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: And when he came near the tents he saw the image of the ox, and the people dancing; and in his wrath Moses let the stones go from his hands, and they were broken at the foot of the mountain.

verses.en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.pt: Então tomou o bezerro que tinham feito, e queimou-o no fogo; e, moendo-o até que se tornou em pó, o espargiu sobre a água, e deu-o a beber aos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
verses.en_bbe: And he took the ox which they had made, burning it in the fire and crushing it to powder, and he put it in the water and made the children of Israel take a drink of it.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.pt: E perguntou Moisés a Arão: Que te fez este povo, que sobre ele trouxeste tamanho pecado?.
verses.en_web: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to Aaron, What did the people do to you that you let this great sin come on them?

verses.en: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.pt: Ao que respondeu Arão: Não se acenda a ira do meu senhor; tu conheces o povo, como ele é inclinado ao mal.
verses.en_web: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
verses.en_bbe: And Aaron said, Let not my lord be angry; you have seen how the purposes of this people are evil.

verses.en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.pt: Pois eles me disseram: Faze-nos um deus que vá adiante de nós; porque, quanto a esse Moisés, o homem que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.
verses.en_web: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
verses.en_bbe: For they said to me, Make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has come to him.

verses.en: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.pt: Então eu lhes disse: Quem tem ouro, arranque-o. Assim mo deram; e eu o lancei no fogo, e saiu este bezerro.
verses.en_web: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off:’ so they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
verses.en_bbe: Then I said to them, Whoever has any gold, let him take it off; so they gave it to me, and I put it in the fire, and this image of an ox came out.

verses.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Moisés viu que o povo estava desenfreado (porque Arão o havia desenfreado, para escárnio entre os seus inimigos),
verses.en_web: When Moses saw that the people had broken loose, (for Aaron had let them loose for a derision among their enemies),
verses.en_bbe: And Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them loose to their shame before their haters:

verses.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.pt: pôs-se em pé à entrada do arraial, e disse: Quem está ao lado do Senhor, venha a mim. Ao que se ajuntaram a ele todos os filhos de Levi.
verses.en_web: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses took his place at the way into the tents, and said, Whoever is on the Lord's side, let him come to me. And all the sons of Levi came together to him.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.pt: Então ele lhes disse: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Israel: Cada um ponha a sua espada sobre a coxa; e passai e tornai pelo arraial de porta em porta, e mate cada um a seu irmão, e cada um a seu amigo, e cada um a seu vizinho.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Yahweh says, the God of Israel, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, This is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: Let every man take his sword at his side, and go from one end of the tents to the other, putting to death his brother and his friend and his neighbour.

verses.en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Levi fizeram conforme a palavra de Moisés; e caíram do povo naquele dia cerca de três mil homens.
verses.en_web: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Levi did as Moses said; and about three thousand of the people were put to death that day.

verses.en: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.pt: Porquanto Moisés tinha dito: Consagrai-vos hoje ao Senhor; porque cada um será contra o seu filho, e contra o seu irmão; para que o Senhor vos conceda hoje uma bênção.
verses.en_web: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, yes, every man against his son, and against his brother; that he may give you a blessing today.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, You have made yourselves priests to the Lord this day; for every one of you has made the offering of his son and his brother; the blessing of the Lord is on you this day.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.pt: No dia seguinte disse Moisés ao povo Vós tendes cometido grande pecado; agora porém subirei ao Senhor; porventura farei expiação por vosso pecado.
verses.en_web: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
verses.en_bbe: And on the day after, Moses said to the people, Great has been your sin: but I will go up to the Lord, and see if I may get forgiveness for your sin.

verses.en: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.pt: Assim tornou Moisés ao Senhor, e disse: Oh! este povo cometeu um grande pecado, fazendo para si um deus de ouro.
verses.en_web: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses went back to the Lord and said, This people has done a great sin, making themselves a god of gold;

verses.en: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, perdoa o seu pecado; ou se não, risca-me do teu livro, que tens escrito.
verses.en_web: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
verses.en_bbe: But now, if you will give them forgiveness--but if not, let my name be taken out of your book.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Aquele que tiver pecado contra mim, a este riscarei do meu livro.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Whoever has done evil against me will be taken out of my book.

verses.en: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.pt: Vai pois agora, conduze este povo para o lugar de que te hei dito; eis que o meu anjo irá adiante de ti; porém no dia da minha visitação, sobre eles visitarei o seu pecado.
verses.en_web: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
verses.en_bbe: But now, go, take the people into that place of which I have given you word; see, my angel will go before you: but when the time of my judging has come, I will send punishment on them for their sin.

verses.en: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.pt: Feriu, pois, o Senhor ao povo, por ter feito o bezerro que Arão formara.
verses.en_web: Yahweh struck the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord sent punishment on the people because they gave worship to the ox which Aaron made.
